aiSemanticSpotChecks.note: Dish location does not prove use; towel preparation does not prove face washing. Responsible-person checking remains explicit; fictional review is not actual score, clinical certification or official passing.

Noise concern is not a personality judgment. Familiar procedural skill does not prove new schedule recall. Physical help does not eliminate wishes for connection or choice; Maslow categories do not rank personal worth.
Homeostasis is a range, not one fixed number. Ear and armpit values are not identical conditions. Time, unit, site, device and personal baseline remain; no temperature diagnosis or threshold added.

No cyanosis is not proof of safety. New breathlessness is promptly connected to healthcare professionals; severe difficulty seeks immediate help through facility emergency procedures. No diagnosis from sputum alone.

Preserved frequency, rhythm, strength, sites and measured conditions. Anatomy identification is not authorization for neck manipulation. Age tendencies are not universal individual predictions; medication conditions are checked with healthcare professionals.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: Do not close a read-only item as though explanation and practice were both checked. An app score or one correction does not certify all care skills, professional approval or passing an official examination.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: Do not mark an item as fully checked in both explanation and practical performance merely because you have read it. An app score or a single correction does not certify overall care skills, professional approval or a pass in the official examination.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: Preparation is known. Recording completed face washing requires a separate check of implementation. Distinguish prepared objects from personal actions.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: We know that the towel has been prepared. Before recording that the person has finished washing their face, separately confirm what they actually did. Distinguish the state of the prepared items from the person’s actions.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: Example wording: ‘The towel is prepared. I haven’t confirmed whether face washing is complete. I’ll check implementation with the person responsible.’
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: Example wording: “I have prepared the towel. I have not yet confirmed whether the person has finished washing their face. I will check what has been done with the person responsible.”

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: [Learning example] Skillful use of familiar scissors can coexist with difficulty recalling a newly heard schedule. One skill does not prove all memory preserved. Record abilities and difficulties separately and arrange needed assessment.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: [Learning example] A person may be able to use familiar scissors but have difficulty remembering a schedule they have just heard. This is not necessarily a contradiction. One retained skill does not show that all memory is preserved. Record what the person can do separately from their difficulties and arrange the necessary assessment.

targetedParagraphRepairs.before: Bluish-purple lips or nails, called cyanosis, are an important change that can relate to insufficient oxygen. Absence of this color change does not establish safety. Promptly connect new breathlessness with a healthcare professional; with severe difficulty or other urgent conditions, immediately seek help under facility emergency procedures.
targetedParagraphRepairs.after: Bluish-purple coloring of the lips or nails, called cyanosis, is an important change that may be associated with insufficient oxygen. However, the absence of this color change does not establish that the person is safe. Promptly seek assessment by a healthcare professional for new breathlessness. In an emergency, such as severe breathing difficulty, immediately seek help according to the facility’s emergency procedures.
